source.note: One row per finding from RVL's review of the BS-23 closure report against docs/handover/feature-docs. Edit this file and re-run scripts/generate_feature_matrix.py; Status and Notes columns entered in the workbook are preserved.

rows.pdf_says: p18 test scope describes a working Agent Application: SMS-based credential login, offline ticket scanning & sale marking, resale prevention with error 'The following tickets are already sold: Ticket IDs', max 4 tickets per scan session, customer mobile capture.
rows.docs_say: X-13 / A-26 manage Agent-pool accounts and POST /ticketing/api/v1/offline-sold-ticket exists, but no agent client is in the five handed-over repos and nothing reads OfflineSoldTickets back (Q-07 suspected exactly this).
rows.action: Request the agent-app source repository (incl. its SMS login flow) from BS-23, then document it as a new feature doc and matrix row.

rows.topic: Real-time entry monitoring in checker app
rows.pdf_says: p7 (in scope) and p18 (test scope): ticket checkers get live entry counts per gate and event for crowd control.
rows.docs_say: C-01..C-06 contain no entry-count screen; counts appear only in the admin gate reports (A-19) after the S-14 sync.
rows.action: Confirm whether the shipped checker app shows live entry counts; if yes, add the missing C-feature doc.

rows.pdf_says: p23-24: 663/663 test cases passed, 54 critical + 95 high defects all resolved before UAT sign-off, 87 medium/low still open in AWS DevOps with agreed timelines.
rows.docs_say: Our independent code review logged 23 defect-rated findings (99-open-queries section 5), including the fully unauthenticated issue-chat REST API (Q-46).
rows.action: Share our defect list with BS-23; request their full defect log including the 87 open medium/low items; reconcile classifications.

rows.pdf_says: p17: UAT confirmed proper Bengali/English language switching with consistent UI rendering across the portal.
rows.docs_say: Q-44 (defect): the switch is client-side only; database content is never translated - the largest single gap for a Bangla-first launch.
rows.action: Ask what UAT covered (portal chrome vs content); scope the translation work.

rows.pdf_says: p6: Content Management manages T&C, Privacy, FAQs and Notices with a rich text editor with version control and publishing workflow.
rows.docs_say: A-29: plain text stored in image-named columns; no versioning, no preview, no approval - an edit is live at once; HTML stored unsanitised (Q-33).
rows.action: Confirm no newer build adds versioning; otherwise treat the PDF wording as embellishment.

rows.pdf_says: p8 (AMC items): improved ticket pricing & reporting accuracy including partner sale data and balance tracking.
rows.docs_say: A-22 documents booking, sales, revenue and payment-discrepancy reports; no partner-sale balance report exists anywhere in the docs.
rows.action: Ask which screen/report shows partner-sale balances; extend A-22 if one exists.

rows.pdf_says: p15/p19: test objectives and E2E scope cover refund processing; inventory 'incremented correctly upon cancellations or refunds'.
rows.docs_say: No refund path exists in the five repos; the only mention is an example chat message in A-24 ('Refunded by the payment gateway').
rows.action: Confirm refunds are gateway-side manual operations rather than a platform feature; note the answer in P-06.

rows.pdf_says: p12-14: Amazon DynamoDB is a data-layer component for ticket scan logs and real-time event tracking.
rows.docs_say: Checked tickets live in Redis and sync via S-14; the architecture doc says the DynamoDB SDK is referenced in ETP.Core.Storage but actual use is not verified.
rows.action: Ask whether any deployed component (e.g. the agent app) uses DynamoDB; record the answer in the architecture doc.

rows.pdf_says: p12/13: Amazon SNS distributes notifications and operational alerts.
rows.docs_say: No SNS usage in the five repos; email = SES (X-21), SMS = external notification service (X-22), push = FCM (X-23).
rows.action: Confirm whether SNS exists in the deployment (e.g. operational alerts) or is PDF boilerplate.

rows.pdf_says: p7: VAT disbursement is fully managed by the payment gateway and the platform does not handle any VAT split logic internally.
rows.docs_say: S-10: the platform posts a VAT challan to NBR (VatChallanProcessing queue) for every DgePay-confirmed paid order.
rows.action: Reconcile who submits and pays what (platform challan vs gateway disbursement) before go-live accounting.

rows.topic: Aurora vs RDS, single vs per-service DB
rows.pdf_says: p12: Aurora PostgreSQL with read/write replicas. p21: 'AWS RDS PostgreSQL instances'. The report contradicts itself.
rows.docs_say: Q-02 (open): every DbContext uses schema etp but each service has its own connection string - one database or one per service is unsettled.
rows.action: Resolve from the infrastructure/credentials pack (CC-20) and close Q-02.

rows.pdf_says: p8 (out of scope): 'Ethiopian (+251) dial code implemented across registration, login'.
rows.docs_say: The platform is Bangladeshi (+880); the seeded fake OneID user is +8801700000011.
rows.action: Almost certainly copied from another client's scope; confirm no +251 handling exists anywhere.

rows.topic: Out-of-scope order/seat caps vs existing settings
rows.pdf_says: p9 (out of scope): Order Per Event and Maximum Seat Per Event configuration as future work.
rows.docs_say: A-03 program settings already carry purchase limits and A-08 overrides them per event (per-user order cap included).
rows.action: Clarify what is actually new beyond today's limits (e.g. per-event totals vs per-user caps).

rows.pdf_says: p9 out-of-scope Ticket Counter App items (batch monitoring, direct printing, POS layout, ticket-operator role); the embedded reviewer comment states these are 'new features for DITF', not GOBCB.
rows.docs_say: Not applicable to GOBCB; recorded so nobody chases them as gaps later.
rows.action: None - record only.

rows.pdf_says: p13: Scheduler 'manages time-based tasks such as event reminders, ticket expiry, and scheduled reporting jobs'.
rows.docs_say: Its 17 workers do capacity updates/reconcile, payment revalidation, ticket generation/signing/merge, VAT challan, FCM delivery, cleanups and promo/discount status (S-01..S-17) - none of the listed examples.
rows.action: Treat the PDF wording as boilerplate; no code change expected.

rows.pdf_says: p13: Push Notification Service (Firebase) 'sends email and SMS notifications for ticket confirmations via SNS'.
rows.docs_say: PushNotification only delivers FCM push; email is SES via Ticketing; SMS goes through the external notification service.
rows.action: Note the inaccuracy; no action on code.

rows.pdf_says: p10: 'Complete system feature list' transferred via shared drive.
rows.docs_say: Our matrix documents 103 features from code; a formal diff needs their list.
rows.action: Request the feature-list document and diff it against the Feature Matrix sheet.

rows.pdf_says: p10/p23: test plan, 663 test cases, execution & defect reports, performance report (P95 < 1.9 s at 600 users, QR validation 100%), UAT sign-off, release notes, deployment guide - on TestRail / AWS DevOps / shared drive.
rows.docs_say: None of these artefacts are in the workspace.
rows.action: Obtain and archive; record the performance baseline for ops reference.

rows.topic: Deliverable: user manuals and Figma design
rows.pdf_says: p10-11: administrator manuals (PDF/video) for venue, program, event creation, ticket generation and reporting; Figma design link for the whole system.
rows.docs_say: Not present in the workspace.
rows.action: Obtain links/files and store them with the handover documentation.

rows.pdf_says: p11: full AWS infrastructure details - RDS connection strings, S3 buckets, payment-gateway API keys, FCM credentials, SMTP configuration and third-party secrets.
rows.docs_say: Would directly resolve several Deployment-kind open queries (Q-02, Q-04, Q-08, Q-16, Q-19...).
rows.action: Obtain via a secure channel and store in the secrets vault - never in this repository.

rows.pdf_says: p10: source-code deliverable covers frontend (Angular), backend (.NET) and infrastructure-as-code assets on the shared drive.
rows.docs_say: Five repos were received; the agent app (CC-01) is missing, so the source deliverable is incomplete relative to what was tested. Any IaC/pipeline repos are also not in the workspace.
rows.action: Confirm the definitive repository list (incl. IaC/pipelines) and obtain the missing agent app.

rows.pdf_says: p10: internal team upskilling on frameworks, business logic, testing, debugging, deployment and operations is a delivered item.
rows.docs_say: No knowledge-transfer sessions are scheduled or recorded post-closure.
rows.action: Agree knowledge-transfer sessions and topics with BS-23 while AMC terms still apply.

rows.pdf_says: Cover page says 'Version 1.0' while the revision table says 1.2 (03-08-2026); about 17 internal reviewer comments remain embedded; the signing-off page (p27) is blank.
rows.action: Request the cleaned, actually-signed final PDF for the records.

rows.pdf_says: p8-9 formally excludes: booking-verification binding removal, verified/non-verified badges removal, one-time phone login, encrypted QR (+ checker scanning), VDS/QR configuration in program settings, ticket-holder-name field config, category-wise quantity input, batch report, pass-checker report, per-event order/seat caps, OneID pass scan.
rows.docs_say: None of these are implemented in the five repos (offline-sold exists backend-only).
rows.action: Keep as product-backlog input; revisit after the verification sessions.

rows.topic: Functional scope baseline matches our docs
rows.pdf_says: p5-8 / p15-18: all in-scope functional areas - programs, events, venues, layouts, pricing, promos, discounts, reservations, ticket generation, gates, reports, reconciliation, issues chat, RBAC, media, content, OneID, DgePay, VDS, checker offline flows and status messages, dashboard.
rows.docs_say: All map to our 103 feature docs; the 9-microservice list and Route 53 -> API Gateway -> NLB -> EKS topology match our architecture doc exactly.
rows.action: None - baseline agreement for the BS-23 walkthrough.
